pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Single-line bug fix matching the PR words. The design is the standard one (escape plus ESCAPE clause), so no spec is needed.
No spec file in the change.

New tests cover %, _, a mixed query and a backslash. Each would fail against the old unescaped LIKE. I did not run them, since the Workers vitest environment isn't among the allowed commands. No tests deleted or loosened.
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js; no docs reference search wildcards.
The backslash is escaped along with % and _, and the ESCAPE '\\' literal in the JS string yields ESCAPE '\' in SQL. Parameter binding is retained.
No injection: the query is still bound. The fix removes an unintended wildcard match.
The diff touches no UI files.
